payload.title: Simplify repository automation to Support and Admin Blog agents
payload.body:
## Scope

Remove the multi-agent orchestration, unused CLI surface, recurring fork synchronization, and related noisy GitHub workflows. Retain only:

- Customer Support agent
- Admin Blog agent
- A concise AGENTS.md contract
- Standard GitHub issue, pull-request, and PHP CI workflows

## Evidence

The scheduled `Sync upstream main` workflow repeatedly fails with HTTP 422 and an invalid hard-coded upstream fallback. The repository currently carries many unused roles, handoffs, skills, tool definitions, and CLI commands, making maintenance and agent discovery difficult.

## Acceptance checks

- No scheduled upstream-sync workflow remains.
- Only Support and Admin Blog agent definitions remain.
- Unneeded project CLI scripts and agent artifacts are removed.
- CI runs PHP syntax checks and tests on pull requests and main.
- A simple issue/PR workflow is documented and works without autonomous subagent routing.
- Documentation and maps describe the reduced setup.
